seo.title: Gatorade (PepsiCo): genAI-personalized Squeeze bottle - 200,000 Firefly assets (2024)
seo.meta_description: Gatorade lets athletes design their Squeeze Bottle with genAI (Adobe Firefly) on gatorade.com: 200,000 assets, millions of options, still online.
seo.resume_citable: Gatorade (PepsiCo) launched in 2024 a genAI-driven Squeeze bottle configurator using Adobe Firefly, with 200,000 pre-generated assets and millions of options, still online on gatorade.com more than 18 months later.

faq.q: How does Gatorade's genAI personalization work?
faq.a: On gatorade.com, a Gatorade iD member enters their interests; Adobe Firefly generates a pattern applied to the Squeeze Bottle. Two free designs, then payment in points; bottle at $34.99.

faq.q: Is it just a PR stunt?
faq.a: No. It is a productized D2C feature, connected to the loyalty program, with a dedicated product page still active more than 18 months after launch.

pattern: self-service genAI product personalization on a D2C site
objectif_business: Give a reason to sign up and buy on the D2C channel by letting athletes design a unique bottle, while keeping the iconic visual identity of the Squeeze Bottle.
description: Gatorade put a genAI-driven Squeeze bottle configurator online on gatorade.com, accessible through the free Gatorade iD loyalty platform. The user types in their interests (a sport, a hobby), picks a pattern mood and a palette, and the tool generates a design applied to the bottle without breaking its iconic look. The technology relies on Adobe Firefly Services, with a repository of 200,000 pre-generated assets to handle the load and the personalization. Each member gets two free designs, then pays in loyalty points (200 points per following generation); the custom bottle costs 34.99 dollars. The tool, launched in October 2024, is still available on gatorade.com as of the verification date. It is a productized, durable deployment, not a PR stunt: a D2C feature connected to loyalty, with a dedicated product page still online.

resultats.metrique: Library of pre-generated assets via Adobe Firefly
Custom bottle: 2 free designs, then 200 loyalty points

niveau_preuve.justification: Official PepsiCo release plus an Adobe (partner) case study and press, with liveness confirmed by the gatorade.com product page; the published indicators describe the scale and the model, not yet audited business results, hence C.

stack_technique.detail: Adobe's commercial genAI models used to generate the patterns applied to the Squeeze Bottle, with a repository of 200,000 pre-generated assets to handle the load.
Gatorade's free loyalty platform that carries access to the configurator and payment in points (200 points per generation after two free designs).
Agency that integrated the personalization experience into gatorade.com.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Real time, self-service: each generation is triggered on demand by a Gatorade iD member.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: PepsiCo/Gatorade's design and D2C teams, on Adobe Firefly Services, integration by Work & Co.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The user's prompt and their loyalty account. Without guardrails (moderation, an imposed iconic look, prompt filtering), the output can drift off-brand or produce unwanted content.

etapes.detail: The Gatorade iD member opens the tool on gatorade.com and enters their interests.
Firefly generates a pattern applied to the Squeeze Bottle, keeping the iconic look.
Two free designs, then 200 loyalty points per generation; order of the bottle at 34.99 dollars.
Printing of the chosen design on the bottle and shipping.

playbook.action: Pick a customizable product with strong identity weight and frame the guardrails: imposed brand look, moderation of prompts and outputs.
playbook.livrable: Creative brief + brand and moderation rules

playbook.action: Prototype the configurator on a commercial image model, with the product as a fixed template and the pattern as the only generated area.
Pre-generate an asset library to handle the load and connect the customer account or loyalty program as the entry point.
Connect production to demand (printing the design, shipping) and the checkout.
playbook.livrable: Order-to-production chain tested end to end

playbook.action: Launch, then track sign-ups, conversion rate on the custom product, and moderation incidents.
playbook.livrable: Feature in production with a dashboard

replication.equipe: 1 D2C PM + 1 art director + an integration agency; moderation and customer service absorb the flow at launch
prerequis_data: asset library or a commercial genAI model
stack_possible: Adobe Firefly Services or an equivalent commercial image model
D2C platform with a customer account
replication.premiere_etape: Pick a customizable product with strong identity weight and prototype a genAI configurator with an imposed brand look and prompt guardrails.

statut_vivant.note: The tool is described as still available on gatorade.com and has a dedicated product page active at verification, more than 18 months after launch.

transposable_ue.note: The user enters prompts and the designs are tied to a loyalty account: personal data and user-generated content to be framed (GDPR, moderation, prompt filtering). Under the AI Act, the genAI nature of the tool must remain transparent.
